features.projects: A customer's project record: create, update, delete, list, look up by domain, its configuration, use cases, setup band, restart, and the org-ownership check on a project.
features.pages: The pages of a website project: creating, listing, updating and deleting project pages and their shape.
features.targets: What an audit points at: URL targets, mobile build targets, environments (staging/production) and whether a target is blocked.
features.mobile_builds: Uploaded Android/iOS app builds: artifact upload, build ingress, malware scanning of uploaded files.
features.journeys: User journeys and journey groups audited step by step, and the auth personas (test logins) a journey runs as.
features.audit_agent: The AI agent that performs an audit: its reasoning loop, tools, prompts, what it observes from the screen reader, classifying issues, checkpoints, the audit graph and platform-specific audit logic (web, android, ios).
features.hands: What physically drives the thing being audited: headless browsers and the browser pool, Android emulators and adb, iOS simulators and simctl, real screen readers through Guidepup (NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack), device settings, touch, screen capture, device preflight checks.
features.audit_runs: The lifecycle of an audit run, not its execution: commissioning a local or cloud run, provisioning cloud runner VMs, the run queue (request, dequeue, settle, reconcile), schedules, run history, completion notifications.
features.findings: Accessibility findings: ingesting them from CLI, CI, agents or external tools, authored findings, finding origin/provenance/environment/location, deduplication of findings, rule frequency.
features.tickets: Tickets grouped from findings: agentic tickets, ticket counts, ticket dedup and status, reconciling tickets when a PR closes or a scope is rescanned, PR comments about findings.
features.evidence: The evidence export a customer downloads: assembling, rendering and writing the evidence workbook.
features.descriptions: Image descriptions (the product calls it Descriptions; code calls it glyph): scanning pages for images, generating alt text, reviewing alt text, glyph summaries, lineage, work items.
features.sitemap: Sitemap crawling: listing due crawls, running the sitemap pipeline, computing sitemap diffs, the crawl workflow.
features.billing: What a customer pays for and has used: plans, catalog, subscriptions, checkout, seat usage, quota counts, deducting actions, cloud-run spend. Customer-facing only; staff tools go to platform_admin.
features.access_gates: The yes/no decision whether an org may use a feature right now: feature flags, the capability registry, entitlement enforcement gates (agentic, content, ingest, integrations, workspace). If a file refuses or admits a request, it is here even when the reason is billing.
features.identity: Who the caller is: sessions, login and post-login, users, viewer, API keys, machine tokens, runner tokens, CI tokens.
features.organizations: Organizations and their members: org record, slug, members, invites, leaving an org, first-contact onboarding records.
features.integrations: Connections to outside tools: GitHub App connection, CI scans and CI PR findings, MCP, external finding ingestion endpoints.
features.widget: The accessibility widget served on customer sites: widget data, org fonts used by the widget.
features.platform_admin: Anything only platform staff can reach, whatever it is about: platform billing admin, platform org/project directory and members, banning users, platform project restart.
features.audit_log: The audit log of who did what in an organization.
features.telemetry: Product usage telemetry sent by the CLI, widget or dashboard, and its ingestion.
features.app_shell: The frame of a client app rather than a product feature: dashboard navigation, layouts, page chrome, generic UI components, CLI command parsing, terminal output formatting, local CLI config.
features.shared_plumbing: Generic code about no product concept: the worker entry point that only wires routes, GraphQL builder and type refs, cursors and pagination, error masking, healthchecks, database schema and helpers.

business_rule.description: Decides what is allowed or what outcome happens: eligibility, limits, pricing, gating, status transitions, domain calculations.

api_surface.description: Exposes an endpoint (GraphQL type/field/mutation, RPC handler, HTTP route): parses input, calls other code, shapes output.

persistence.description: Reads or writes storage: SQL queries, R2, KV, repositories.

orchestration.description: Sequences several steps over time: workflows, crons, queues, pipelines.

plumbing.description: Generic helper with no product concept.
